claims.reason: The two proofs repeat the same argument. In `unitriangularStageSuccessorBialgHom` (lines 71-102) and in `bialgHomOfCompQuotient` (UpperTriangularSplitKernel lines 124-162), an algebra map `f` out of an ideal quotient is shown to be a bialgebra map. Both use `Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext` to reduce to `f ∘ q`. For the counit, both rewrite with `f ∘ q = target` and close with `counitAlgHom_comp` for `target` and for `q`. For the comultiplication, both use `map_comp_comulAlgHom` for `q` (after a `change`), `Algebra.TensorProduct.map_comp`, the factorization, and `map_comp_comulAlgHom` for `target`. The hypotheses have the same shape: `q` is a surjective bialgebra map, `target` is a bialgebra map, and `f.comp q = target.toAlgHom`. The stage file takes `q = quotientBialgHom K n r`, `target = quotientBialgHom K n (r+1)` and `f = successor K n r`, with the factorization proved by `rfl`. The upper-triangular file takes `q = upperTriangularQuotientBialgHom K n` and an arbitrary `target`. The only difference is the type names. The 30-line argument with its long `change` blocks would be stated once, and the stage def would become a one-line application. The generic lemmas in Bialgebra/Quotient.lean are stated for `liftₐ` from a bialgebra map. Using them here would mean first constructing `f` as a lift of `target`. The proposed lemma is more convenient, because both sites already have `f` in hand and the factorization is `rfl` in the stage file. The proposed lemma takes any surjective `q`, so it does not need the ideal-quotient presentation. One caveat: the stage file would need a new import, since it currently reaches this code only through other imports. The proposal also needs the generic lemma placed so that it creates no cycle. A new file under AlgebraicGroups/Algebra/Bialgebra/ that imports only Mathlib would avoid one.
claims.shared_lemma: def BialgHom.ofCompSurjective {R A B C : Type*} [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Ring B] [Semiring C] [Bialgebra R A] [Bialgebra R B] [Bialgebra R C] (q : A →ₐc[R] B) (hq : Function.Surjective q) (target : A →ₐc[R] C) (f : B →ₐ[R] C) (h : f.comp q.toAlgHom = target.toAlgHom) : B →ₐc[R] C := BialgHom.ofAlgHom f (counit: apply (AlgHom.cancel_right hq).mp; rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc, h]; exact (BialgHom.counitAlgHom_comp target).trans (BialgHom.counitAlgHom_comp q).symm) (comul: apply (AlgHom.cancel_right hq).mp; rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc, AlgHom.comp_assoc, h, ← BialgHom.map_comp_comulAlgHom q, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc, ← Algebra.TensorProduct.map_comp, h]; exact BialgHom.map_comp_comulAlgHom target)
rewritten_uses: unitriangularStageSuccessorBialgHom K n r := BialgHom.ofCompSurjective (quotientBialgHom K n r) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (quotientBialgHom K n (r + 1)) (successor K n r) rfl
bialgHomOfCompQuotient K n target f h := BialgHom.ofCompSurjective (upperTriangularQuotientBialgHom K n) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective target f h
